properties.name: Clement Ave, Broadway to Grand St

sources.note: Bids for "the Alameda belt line on Clement avenue, from Pearl street west to Grand street", about 6,234 ft.
The first freight "over the new municipal belt line", hauled by a Southern Pacific locomotive.
"Beginning at a point 188 feet, more or less, easterly of the intersection of the center line of Clement avenue and Broadway … to … the westerly line of Grand street, a distance of 6364.5 feet."

properties.notes: The city's contract of 1918 names Pearl St as the east end, the Railroad Commission in 1925 a point 188 ft east of Broadway; drawn from Broadway. The 2.61-mile line of 2012 still began here, at Clement Ave and Broadway.
properties.geometry_method: Along today's Clement Avenue centerline from Broadway to Grand Street (1857 m; Overture 2026-09-23.1); checked on USGS Oakland East 1:24,000 (1949) and USGS Oakland West 1:24,000 (1949). Single track in the center of Clement Ave, from just east of Broadway to Grand St (CRC Decision 15177, 1925).
